prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Houston, Texas, and has back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1290; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just keep it to the accident, if that's okay.
Q: That's fine. For the record, can you confirm you were the driver of the vehicle involved in the collision in Houston, Texas?
A: Yes, I was driving my sedan.
Q: Walk me through what happened.
A: I was changing lanes on the freeway, checking my mirror first. I signaled, started to move over, and then a pickup came up beside me and clipped the rear quarter panel of my car. It pushed me back toward my lane.
Q: Did you see the pickup before the contact?
A: Not really. I think it was in my blind spot. I didn't hear it coming either.
Q: Did the other driver stop or say anything?
A: He pulled onto the shoulder. We exchanged information, and he said he didn't see me coming over.
Q: Were there any police officers or emergency crews at the scene?
A: Yes, an officer came out and wrote up a report. I have the report number at home.
Q: Did you feel any injuries right after the impact?
A: My neck felt stiff, but I thought I'd be fine. By that evening my lower back was really tight and sore.
Q: Have you sought medical treatment since the accident?
A: Yes, I went to urgent care the next day and they diagnosed a back strain. I've been doing physical therapy twice a week.
Q: Did you have any prior problems with your back?
A: I had some occasional stiffness years ago, but nothing that stopped me from working.
Q: Are you currently missing time from work?
A: Some. I've been on light duty and I've missed a few shifts.
Q: Is there anything else you think I should know?
A: Just that I'm trying to get back to normal and I want this handled fairly.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
